zh-CN.title: 成员登录入口更纯粹
items: PWA 选择空间后会直接进入普通用户登录，空间异常页也不再混入创建与管理入口
成员登录页保留昵称密码登录，并在下方提供微信登录选项

en.title: A focused member sign-in
items: Choosing a space in the PWA now opens member sign-in, with no creation or admin entry points on error states
Member sign-in keeps nickname and password access with a WeChat option below
